runs.text: Prime State Systems gives ambitious real-estate teams a clear operating layer for the workflows that move their business.
Real-estate teams don’t need another place to check. They need one calm layer that makes automation legible: what is running, what changed, and where a human should look next.
A shared view for owners, operators, and the systems that support them.
One operating layer. Three moments of clarity.
Subscribed services, current state, and the pulse of the business.
Every workflow run with status, time, records, and duration.
Quick actions and recoverable states when a system needs attention.
The result is less hunting, fewer surprises, and a better handoff between people and systems.
A dashboard that answers the next question.
Visibility is useful only when trust is built in.
Every client sees only their own data.
Loading, empty, failed, paused, and disconnected states are part of the product.
Workflow activity comes from one clear execution source.
Prime State Systems is the operating layer for real-estate automation that teams can actually understand and act on.
